## Rule

Input foreground is color 8 on a 10x10 grid. Find 4-connected foreground components, normalize each component shape by translating it to the origin, then group by that normalized shape. Components whose normalized shape appears more than once are recolored to 1; components whose normalized shape appears once are recolored to 2.
